_: The recordings the analysis engine is pinned against (ADR-0050).
Real drives, committed on purpose. The .gitignore rule in this repo is
regenerate-don't-commit, and it is right for make_fixture.js and
make_drift_fixture.js output — nearly a megabyte of synthetic drive that
any checkout rebuilds byte-identically from a fixed seed. A real drive
cannot be rebuilt from a seed, which is the whole exception.
These files are IMMUTABLE. Never regenerate one to make a test pass. A
recording that needs replacing is a new file, a new name and a new sheet.
To add one: drop the file here, add an entry below, then

fixtures.name: mountbarker-ring-2026-08-22
fixtures.note: The 22 Aug puck ring, off the node whole: 168,105 samples, 12 CAN channels, the gyro, and six real GNSS breaks that were found by hand and written up in docs/IN_THE_CAR_2026-08-22.md before any of the detecting code existed. Carries its own track (Mount Barker Time Trial) and the trace.info the recorder reported, so nothing here depends on what is in anybody's library.
